title.en: HELP, CANCEL and the errors a gateway must answer

goal.en: Besides the five commands, the grammar has HELP and CANCEL, and four error codes a gateway turns into a reply: usage, bad_date, unknown_command and empty. An error means nothing is written.

note.en: HELP: the gateway replies with one example per command, plain ASCII, under 160 characters.
A message that starts with no known keyword: unknown_command.
An OFFER without a quantity: usage.
An OFFER without a storage code: usage.

outcome.en: You can build the reply side of a gateway from these codes. Next: scenario 067 covers the safety checks a gateway applies before writing.
